title: Rubric
description: Machine-readable scoring rubric for a single interview question.

question_id.description: Links this rubric to a question in the question bank. Generic (category-level) rubrics may use a stable placeholder such as 'generic'.

category.description: When set, this rubric is the fallback for every question in that category that has no applicable question-specific rubric.

topic.description: Keywords that must appear in the question text for a question-specific rubric to apply. When they do not, the category fallback is used instead.

hints.description: Progressive hints revealed in guided mode when an answer scores below 2.

expected_concepts.description: List of concepts the answer must address.

scoring_levels.description: Keys are concept strings (must match expected_concepts). Values describe each 0-3 level.

max_score.description: Sum of maximum level (3) across all concepts.
